# Safety Guards & Clean Architecture Requirements Checklist: NexusClean

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and safety rigor of NexusClean requirements across the 5 Golden Safety Rules and 4-Layer OOD Clean Architecture before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow based on `docs/` case study constraints and `spec.md`.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Zero-Data-Loss & Safety Guard Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all protected Windows and user profile root paths (`%LOCALAPPDATA%`, `%APPDATA%`, `%USERPROFILE%`, `C:\Windows`, `C:\Program Files`, `C:\Program Files (x86)`, drive roots) explicitly enumerated in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Do the requirements mandate that hardcoded root and credential protections remain enforced even if an external signature catalog omits or misconfigures them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, DataModel §3.1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all critical browser profile files (`Login Data`, `Login Data For Account`, `Cookies`, `Bookmarks`, `Preferences`, `Secure Preferences`, `Web Data`, `History`, `Extension Cookies`, `Extensions`) explicitly listed as non-deletable across Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Cốc Cốc? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are allowlisted browser cache subdirectories restricted to an explicit closed list rather than wildcard folder matching? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Is fail-closed guard behavior specified when any guard in the chain returns `Block` or encounters an evaluation failure (`PROTECTED_NEVER_DELETE`, `RiskScore = 10`)? [Consistency, Constitution §III, DataModel §1.3]

## 5-Tier Impact Analysis & Relocation Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are risk score boundaries (`0–10`) and default checkbox pre-selection rules unambiguously defined for each of the five `ImpactLevel` tiers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010, DataModel §1.1]
- [ ] CHK007 Do requirements specify every mandatory Vietnamese explanation field (`SummaryVi`, `SideEffectIfDeleted`, `PreservedAssets`, `RecommendedAction`) required before user confirmation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the minimum free-space safety buffer (`SourceSize + 20%`) explicitly quantified for Secondary Drive Relocation target validation? [Clarity, Spec §US3, DataModel §2.4]
- [ ] CHK009 Are fallback requirements specified when a machine has only a single partition (`C:`) and no secondary fixed drive for relocation? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §US3]

## Process Locks, Administrator Boundary & Dry-Run Measurability

- [ ] CHK010 Is non-destructive Dry-Run accuracy quantified with a measurable tolerance (`99%` match on unlocked items with zero disk mutations)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for how active file locks are reported and skipped without freezing or aborting unlocked items in the same batch? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Are standard user-space operations clearly separated from UAC Administrator-elevated maintenance operations (`System Volume Information`, WSL virtual disks), including user cancellation of the elevation prompt? [Clarity, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 Do elevated maintenance contracts prohibit arbitrary shell command strings in favor of strictly parameterized operations and minimum restore-point retention (`>= 2 GB`)? [Completeness, Contracts §3]

## Edge Cases, Extensibility & Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Are filesystem reparse points, junctions, symbolic links, and cloud-only placeholder files (`OneDrive` hydration avoidance) explicitly addressed in directory sizing and cleanup requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Do duplicate IDE extension pruning requirements account for platform-qualified semantic versions (`win32-x64`), active `extensions.json` references, and interrupted `.uuid` temporary folders? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Are scan latency (`< 15 seconds`), cancellation responsiveness (`< 2 seconds`), and near-zero free-disk operation (`< 100 MB` free with bounded audit log rotation) quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Are all 8 `CleanupActionType` values consistent across the JSON signature catalog schema, Domain data model, and Strategy assignments? [Consistency, DataModel §1.2, Contracts `signature-rules.v1.schema.json`]
- [ ] CHK018 Do automated testing requirements strictly prohibit executing mutating cleanup tests outside isolated temporary sandbox directories? [Completeness, Constitution §VI]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
